title: Senior Digital Analytics Consultant

Our mission is to empower life sciences: helping scientists understand mechanisms of disease and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized, safer, and more efficient treatment and testing strategies.
As a scientific consultancy serving regulated industries, the quality and traceability of our work are central to our value proposition. title: Senior Compliance Manager, Derivatives Trade Reporting
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Senior Compliance Officer to build and run our global derivatives trade and transaction reporting function. The function covers CFTC swap data reporting under Part 45, EU transaction reporting under MiFIR, EU derivatives reporting under EMIR, UK MiFIR and UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting across multiple OKX entities and a growing derivatives product set. These regimes have different scopes, reporting parties, data requirements and destinations. You will determine how they apply to OKX’s activities and help build a reliable process for meeting each obligation.

 

Most of the work is data and judgment: deciding what is reportable, by which entity, and to whom, then making sure the right trade and lifecycle data reaches the right swap data repository, trade repository, or regulator on time and reconciles to our trading records. You will own reporting scoping/eligibility, submission monitoring, and the controls that show our reports are complete, accurate, and timely.

 

This is a hands-on Compliance leadership role. You will work with Trading, Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, local Compliance teams and reporting providers, and you will lead regulatory change in this space. Responsibilities for source data, systems, submissions and remediation will be agreed across those teams; you will lead the compliance framework and stay close enough to the process to identify and proactively resolve problems. You will report to the Head of Markets and Product Compliance and support a central function that owns reporting interpretation, scoping, oversight, and remediation for every entity in scope.

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Interpret and apply derivatives and transaction reporting rules across global regimes, including CFTC Part 45, MiFIR Article 26, EMIR Article 9, UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and the ASIC Derivative Transaction Rules (Reporting) 2024, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and outside counsel.

•
Own and maintain entity, product, and transaction-level reporting scoping and eligibility: which entity reports, which products and lifecycle events are in scope, which counterparty role triggers the obligation, and which repository or authority receives the report.

•
Oversee, support, and help maintain the daily reporting process. Monitor submissions against deadlines, including T+1 for MiFIR transaction reports, investigate rejections and breaks, and track each one to resolution.

•
Reconcile reported activity to trading records and repository data, and coordinate corrections and back-reporting with the teams that own the relevant systems and data.

•
Define and maintain the reporting data specification with Engineering and Data, including field-level mapping, reference data such as LEIs, UTIs, UPIs, and ISINs, and the validation rules applied before submission.

•
Build and run the control framework: completeness, accuracy, and timeliness checks, exception management, management information, and records that hold up to regulator and audit review.

•
Drive reporting readiness

Every query you answer helps an organisation keep talking to the people who rely on it: a mother getting a vaccine reminder, a refugee finding services, a health worker getting a test result. Many of the people who write to us work in small teams, under pressure, and aren't technical. They need someone kind, clear and quick.
At Turn .io, AI does the first pass on much of support. Plain drafts replies, finds similar past threads and flags gaps in our knowledge base. Through MCP servers, our AI tools can look into a customer's Turn setup, our Linear issues and HubSpot. That doesn't make the human less important. It means you spend less time searching, and more time understanding the problem, solving it properly and making sure the customer feels looked after.
The role blends frontline support with the first layer of support engineering. You'll solve more technical SaaS issues yourself than support teams used to, and escalate only with a clear diagnosis. You'll be based in Brazil and look after customers worldwide, with a focus on Latin America.
What you'll do
Look after our customers

• Be the friendly first response in Plain, Slack and email, within our SLAs, in plain language.

• Own each query until it's resolved, and keep the customer updated even while it's with engineering.

• Notice when a customer is stressed or stuck, and go the extra step: a call, a walkthrough, a check-in after a fix.

Solve problems with AI and MCP tools

• Use Claude with the Plain, Linear and Turn MCP servers to investigate: read thread history, check account setup, find related bugs and draft replies.

• Review every AI-drafted reply before it goes out. Check the facts, the tone, and that it actually answers the question. You're accountable for what we send.

• Handle technical questions that used to go to Support Engineering: journeys and automations that misbehave, webhook and API errors, rejected WhatsApp templates, and Meta account or number issues.

• Escalate to Product engineering with a clear write-up: what happened, how to reproduce it, what you've ruled out, and the impact on the customer.

Make support better every week

•
Turn repeated questions into knowledge base articles written so both customers and Plain's AI can use them.

• Work through Plain's knowledge gap reports.

• Tag themes and flag at-risk accounts for the Customer Success Lead's weekly health review.

• Test new features before launch and give QA feedback.

What we're looking for

• Kind, patient and warm. You enjoy helping people, and it shows in your writing.

• Driven by impact. It matters to you that our customers serve vulnerable people.

• Some customer support or customer-facing experience, ideally with a SaaS or technical product. This can also be your first job if you have a technical background, such as a degree, course or your own projects, and you love working with people.

• Daily use of AI tools, with the judgment to check what they produce.

• Technical curiosity: happy to read an API error, look at a webhook payload or follow a log. Some experience with APIs, JSON or basic SQL is a plus.

• Professional working English and Portuguese, written and spoken. Spanish or French is a plus.

• Calm and organised under pressure.

KPIs and success metrics
Primary KPIs

• First response and resolution times within SLA.

• Customer satisfaction score.

• Share of queries resolved without escalation.

Monitoring KPIs

• Quality of escalations: engineering rarely needs to ask follow-up questions.

• Knowledge base articles added or updated.

• Reopened tickets.
